name: @umber-style-examples/static-themes
description: A static page made with UmberStyle and React: light, dark and brand themes as a class on <html>, the stored choice applied before the first paint, nested themes, a theme added at run time and an override through the style prop.

scripts.start: npm run build && npm run preview
scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && vite build --ssr src/prerender.tsx --outDir build/ssr && node build/ssr/prerender.js
